records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Product revenue accounted for 48% of our consolidated revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2022, as compared to 44% for the three months ended March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The ongoing shift to the cloud, along with the widespread advancement of artificial intelligence (“AI”) across the data center, edge and Internet of Things (“IoT”) end points, has led to exponential growth in data usage and tremendous demands on data infrastructure.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Changes in operating assets and liabilities for the three months ended March 31, 2022 primarily included decreases in unbilled receivables, inventories and increases in accounts payable, offset by increases in accounts receivable, and decreases in accrued salaries and benefits and deferred revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cost of product revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2022 increased approximately $7.0 million as compared to the same period in 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, our cash provided by operating activities for the first quarter of 2022 was $42.6 million.
